# ashlr-plugin

> Install with npm, call the CLI with --json, and register the ashlr-mcp server.

Agents are first-class users. The runnable reference is [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-plugin/blob/main/llms-full.txt). The rendered documentation corpus is [plugin.ashlr.ai/llms-full.txt](https://plugin.ashlr.ai/llms-full.txt).

## Start

- [Runnable reference](https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-plugin/blob/main/llms-full.txt): install, JSON CLI, and MCP snippets for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex
- [README](https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-plugin/blob/main/README.md): same path, plus the benchmark note and the command table
- [Rendered index](https://plugin.ashlr.ai/llms.txt): headings from the README and the docs site
- [Rendered full docs](https://plugin.ashlr.ai/llms-full.txt): README and public docs in one file

## Docs

- [Install](https://plugin.ashlr.ai/docs/getting-started/install): host install steps generated from the README
- [Capabilities](https://plugin.ashlr.ai/docs/capabilities): tools, hosts, and agent entry points
- [MCP tools](https://plugin.ashlr.ai/docs/tools): catalog
- [Commands](https://plugin.ashlr.ai/docs/skills): slash commands and workflow skills
- [Multi-host MCP](https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-plugin/blob/main/docs/multi-host-mcp.md): Claude, Cursor, Codex, and other hosts
- [Codex quickstart](https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-plugin/blob/main/docs/codex-quickstart.md): Codex plugin and MCP
- [Benchmarks](https://plugin.ashlr.ai/benchmarks): per-call savings and how to reproduce them
- [Pricing](https://plugin.ashlr.ai/pricing): free local plugin, optional Pro and Team
- [Privacy](https://plugin.ashlr.ai/privacy): telemetry is off unless you opt in
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-plugin/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules for agents editing this repository
